messages:
alejandra_sales: Heads-up: partner ops asked for a quick sync on compatibility windows across B200/H100/H200/MI300/Gaudi. They want clear calendar slots for marketplace enablement and SI onboarding this quarter.

kevin_eng: Thanks. From runtime team: biggest risk = B200 firmware mismatch with our CUDA ABI shim (we still have to validate fallback path). ETA for a mitigation build is ~9 business days.

tom_habana: For Gaudi: runtime 2.1rc is feature-complete. We can drop images earlier if we get the integration checklist. Note: wheel naming changed in last build, SI will need updated pip links.

sven_amd: MI300 images ready end-of-week. We still need to confirm perf numbers for 8k+ context workloads; run takes ~3 days.

alejandra_sales: Important: several customers requested simultaneous marketplace SKU availability. Can we support same-day listings for multiple vendors or do we need staggered marketplace waves?

tara_si: SI perspective: prefer short staggering (48-72h) to reduce install churn and allow rollback if a package fails. Also need official artifact URLs for our installer.

deploy_bot: NOTE: marketplace entries require partner-provided logos, SKUs, and RTB copy. Uploads must be completed 7 days before public.

kevin_eng: Action from eng: if vendors can drop images into the lab bucket with a stable tag, we'll kick off automated validation (smoke + perf). Please follow naming: redwood-<vendor>-<arch>-<date>.img

sven_amd: Confirming we'll follow that tag. Also flagging a certing dependency: kernel 6.5 needed for MI300 kernel features. Any objections?

kevin_eng: No objections but call it out in release notes; we need to surface kernel reqs in the compatibility matrix.

alejandra_sales: Can vendors reply with absolute earliest image drop + any press/embargo constraints by EOD Tue? We'll use that to set marketplace waves.

tom_habana: Gaudi images: earliest drop Tue evening. No press embargo from our side.
sven_amd: MI300 images: Friday. No embargo. Long-seq perf numbers by Monday.

tara_si: I'll prepare an integration checklist template and post a link. Need images and pip wheels to validate SI installers.

deploy_bot: ACTION: created calendar placeholders for three waves: gaudi, mi300, nvidia-h200. Placeholders id=cal-200111.

alejandra_sales: Great. I'll compile a one-pager for GTM and ops with these slots and share with legal for embargo checks. Thanks everyone.
